blocks.html:
HepCURE – Ambulance Full Wrap – Truck Wrap

We’re Vinyl Wrap Toronto, and we’ve got a little bit of news for you: we just wrapped an ambulance for HepCURE!

HepCURE is a non-profit dedicated to diminishing Hepatitis C in Canada. They work with people who have been diagnosed with the disease, their family and friends, and local communities to help them cope with the diagnosis and get the treatment they need. They also run awareness campaigns and provide information about the disease and its effects on those who have it.

They reached out to us because they wanted a way to increase their visibility while they were on the road—and after installing this ambulance full wrap, it’s clear that this was an excellent idea. The ambulance full wrap looks great, it’s easy to clean, and it doesn’t fade or scratch easily. It’s also waterproof!

If you want your own brand to have an ambulance full wrap (or any other vehicle), we’ll do it for you! Just contact us and let us know what type of vehicle you have in mind and we’ll get started on your project. We’ll wrap your vehicle in a custom color and design that fits your brand perfectly. So, if you’re looking for a quality ambulance full wrap that is guaranteed to last, look no further. We’ve got what you need!

If you would like to personalize your car, truck, boat, or other personal items – as long as it fits into our garage and has a smooth surface, we would love to wrap it! For your inspiration or your next partial wrap with Vinyl Wrap Toronto, do not forget to check out our Portfolio.

Get a Free Quote today by filling out the form and our team will get back to you as soon as possible. You can reach us at 416-746-1381 or email us at info@vinylwraptoronto.com. You can also visit us at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4.

Don’t forget to follow us on Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and Pinterest to hear about our special deals, creative wrap projects, and vehicle branding.
